caption: The drawing depicts a wooden manual coffee grinder placed centered against a plain, light beige background. The grinder is cubic in shape with visible dovetail joints at the corners, and is colored in various shades of brown to represent the wood. The front face has a round, metal handle on a small crank that extends horizontally from the top, with the handle swerving slightly upward and ending in a rounded knob. The front side of the grinder also includes a circular metal plate and a small drawer with a round knob at the bottom right, which is likely used to collect the ground coffee. The overall composition is simple, focusing solely on the coffee grinder, with no other objects or distractions in the background.
title: Coffee Grinder
